title: Fantastic trip
text:
Fantastic trip with Samuel who was superb - very knowledgeable and great company and enthusiastic 
Highly recommend this trip
author: JDLPORTUGAL

title: Don’t Miss This Tour of Barcelona
text:
Diana was fabulous!
Her enthusiasm, passion and knowledge were outstanding and informative. You truly gain a real understanding about the History and Culture of this Amazing City! 
We thoroughly enjoyed the tour and highly recommend it!
author: Lisa_M

title: The tuk tuk experience
text:
This is the first time we took a tuk tuk. We had a great guide with Yago. He was happy to share his love of Barcelona with us.  Though it was a cold, windy day. He did his best to make sure we were comfortable.
It was a good experience.
author: Peggy_A

title: Tuk tuk
text: Awesome tour of the city!! Our tour guide was excellent! We loved the ease of being in the tuk tuk
author: F1589ARkimc

title: Tuk tuk fun
text: Samuel was an excellent guide. He gave comprehensive information and made the trip very enjoyable. He even added a little extra detour at the end. The tuk tuk was fun to ride in. Communication before the tour was excellent, even including a picture of where to meet.
author: jmfergzz

title: Excellent tour, ask for Simone!
text: Our guide, Simone was absolutely outstanding. He knew the city so well and took the time to show us interesting and beautiful sights, answering questions and providing additional detail. Tuk tuk tours are always the way to go in these busy cities, but the guide is the one that makes them memorable. We rate this 10 out of 5 stars!!
author: 931debrae

title: Amanda
text: Amanda was an exceptional tour guide. She was extremely knowledgeable and personable! I give her 5 stars!!!
author: Marcy_R

title: This was a very fun...
text: This was a very fun experience.  Our guide, Amanda, was awesome.  She was very informative and showed us some amazing sites.  She is very proud to live in Barcelona, and you could tell by her enthusiasm.  I would highly suggest this tour.  I was sad when it was over!
author: Stacey_P

title: Great way to explore Barcelona!
text: Great way to explore Barcelona. We were slightly delayed and Ilarya was kind and patient and allowed us to still take our time at stops and get the full experience. We booked the 3 hour tour.
author: helenrQ900AF

title: Great way to view Barcelona. Recommending doing this day 1 or 2
text: Great way to see all of Barcelona. Definitely recommend doing it day 1 or 2 as you get a great idea of what you want to see. Can’t remember our guides name but he was very knowledgeable. Highly recommend
author: Derrick_B
